about: What mc kit fill-bucket gives you: the Fill Bucket. Build only the outline of a wall, floor or line, then use the bucket on the inside of a block: it fills the hole with the same block, like the paint bucket in Paint. Use it on a staircase you started (any stair blocks, even a single one, or up, straight, up, straight...) and it keeps building the pattern until something is in the way or the line you built goes another way. Sneak and use it in the air to change its mode: the bucket in your hand changes picture (plain = Auto, green steps = Stairs, blue wall = Wall, orange floor = Floor). Use it in the air within 3 seconds to undo. With --craft, also what crafts another one.
